verses.1: The blood of the sacrificer can be seen here; it was taken from the city, and it became a source of bloodshed.
verses.2: The cities of destruction will become ruins. They will be destroyed, and there will be no one left to live in them.
verses.3: And the tribes of Egypt, and the kingdom of Damscok, and all of Israel will be blessed by God’s army.
verses.4: And on that day, the glory of Jacob would be diminished, and from Masham will come no more words.
verses.5: And it will be like when the harvest of crops is gathered, and the seeds are stored away. It will be like when the grains are collected from the fertile fields.
verses.6: And it remained there, like a lampstand with two or three branches on top. In its branches were four or five lamps. “Hear, O LORD God of Israel!”
verses.7: On that day, man will be punished for his actions. And our eyes will see Israel’s holiness.
verses.8: And they shall not be able to see the works of their hands. The things that they have made with their own hands will not be visible to anyone. Nor will those who are black and dark-skinned be able to see them.
verses.9: On that day, the cities of Moab will be like those abandoned by the wind and rain. It will be a time when the Amorites will be driven away from before the children of Israel.
verses.10: For you have forgotten the God who saves you. You have also forgotten your own nature. Therefore, you will be led astray by evil thoughts and strange songs.
verses.11: On the day you are planted, I will bring forth your fruit; in the morning, your seeds will bloom. There will be harvests on that day, and there will also be pain.
verses.12: Oh, how many nations are like the seas! Their waters are vast and endless. They are like the great seas that carry their own weight.
verses.13: To those who live in vast seas, they will be carried away by the waves. They will become distressed and flee from their surroundings. They will be chased like fugitives before the wind, and like shadows before the sun.
verses.14: At dusk, and in the darkness before dawn, it isn’t our part to take control of it. It belongs to those who are stronger than us.
